Version 11 (October 28, 2026; this paper) answers an eighth review, a code audit and reproduction from the public archive (RESPONSE-TO-REVIEW-8.md; no experiment was run). Figure 3 (version 1, superseded) drew two negative LM means at +0.05, with their intervals shifted, and its legend overlapped an axis label; both are corrected. The energy model now counts a classification run’s optimizer steps from the rows its layers trained: the run records’ sample count includes each epoch’s incomplete last batch, which training skips, so the transfer reads were overstated by 0.16 %. No printed number changed; the largest change in a total energy is 0.0005 % in the current projection and 0.0014 % in version 1’s. Section 3 now discloses an off-by-one in the LM sampler. The simulator’s ideal reset of a partial column selection under AIHWKIT bounds, which no result used, no longer fails, and a new check covers it.
